_about: karma's reads on players that the numbers can't see. Kept by hand. 'motor': high-intensity player whose output rises with his minutes; never take an under on him when a starter at his position is out. 'small_ball_5': plays centre in small lineups, so there is rebound upside when the bigs sit. 'primary_guard_defender': guards the opponent's main ball-handler, so his minutes hold up whatever happens to his shooting. 'rebounds_suppressed_with_giannis': fade this player's rebound overs when Giannis plays.

Baylor Scheierman.note: High-intensity player, maximises any minutes he gets (karma, 5 Nov 2026). Started for the resting Tatum on 4 Nov: 29 min, 9 pts, 11 reb; our under 12.5 PR lost. The model had him at 24.6 min and 4.5 reb.

Mario Hezonja.note: Big role for now (karma, 6 Nov). Peyton Watson has a nagging hamstring and could be in and out of the lineup all season. Hezonja is probably CLE's best defender on opposing primary guards, which keeps his minutes steady, and he plays the 5 when they go small, which is where the rebounds come from. Rebounding above his minutes: 31 Oct 20 min, 11 reb; 2 Nov 27 min, 12/8; 4 Nov 23 min, 12/8 after Allen left injured in Q1.
Mario Hezonja.review: 2026-12-01 (Watson coming back no longer ends the role on its own, given the nagging hamstring)

Stephen Curry.note: On a 30-point streak during GSW's five-game win streak: about 33 ppg, nearly 48% from three on 11-12 attempts, about 8.5 FTA and 5.5 ast. More rim attacks and fouls drawn than usual. GSW rest him on some nights for maintenance (7 starting lineups in 8 games), which drags his season minutes down.
Stephen Curry.source: The Dunker Spot podcast (Yahoo Sports, Nekias Duncan & Steve Jones), 4 Nov 2026 -- shared by karma

Yaxel Lendeborg.note: Rookie with a big and growing usage: post-ups, one-on-one, playmaking out of drives. First rookie with multiple 6+ three games in his first 7. The hosts expect up-and-down nights (quiet vs PHX and the night before LAC).
Yaxel Lendeborg.source: The Dunker Spot podcast (Yahoo Sports, Nekias Duncan & Steve Jones), 4 Nov 2026 -- shared by karma

Brandin Podziemski.note: The hosts rate him as just good: shoots, drives, playmakes, crashes the offensive glass, takes charges. GSW guards and wings are getting extra offensive rebounds as a team.

_team_notes.GSW: Source: Dunker Spot, 4 Nov. Forcing lots of turnovers; extra offensive rebounds from guards and wings; ice/shade sideline handoffs. Steph and Draymond sit some nights for maintenance. Niang +20 in 21 min vs PHX; Bassey a strong screener in random starts.
_team_notes.DAL: Source: Dunker Spot, 4 Nov. Leads the league in zone possessions by a wide margin. Gafford leads them in offensive rebounds, with Risacher second. Max Christie's defence has been weak.
_team_notes.MIA: Source: Dunker Spot, 4 Nov. Luka torched them on the second night of a back-to-back: Davion Mitchell too small, Wiggins no answer, Bam only some good possessions. Elite guards can get loose against their perimeter defence.

Bam Adebayo.note: karma, watching MIA@GSW live (5 Nov US): Bam plays power forward next to Giannis, who takes the rebounds. Bam is pulled away from the rim to contest corner threes, so he is out of rebounding position. When Giannis sits, Portis comes in at centre (not Bam). In-game check: 1 reb in 11 min in Q1. So fade Bam's rebound overs when Giannis plays; Giannis's rebound overs look better. karma: he is still scoring (7 pts in Q1). The role moves his output from rebounds to points, so his points overs are fine and rebounds are the stat to fade.
Bam Adebayo.review: check over the next 3-5 MIA games with Giannis playing

Bobby Portis Jr..note: Backup centre when Giannis sits (karma, live 5 Nov US).
